newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel threatens cracked market.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel threatens cracked market.

text.p: NWE straight run was a pivot for weaker cracked prices amid talk Russian material would filter into the cracked market, but little trade was done on Monday.
The NWE sector was seen well supplied amid steady Russian imports which threatened to create an overhang again. An M-100 was heard offered to a U.K. end user at no premium to cracked.

Dealers said low sulphur prices and activity were static with $125 fob still a discussion point. Steady to narrowly firmer crude gave sellers a boost. High sulphur straight run was assessed around formula +$3.
